name: Poly Chorus Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Poly Chorus by music style: synthwave, ambient, cinematic, pop, trance, house, deep house, funk & disco, soul, electro, lo-fi and techno. Six sounds per style: bass, lead, pad, chords, plucks and textures, all with the built-in stereo chorus. Also has Dancefloor DnB, Liquid DnB, Neuro Pads and Jungle folders.
